mutation PatchEnvGroupEnvironment($id: String!, $envVars: [EnvGroupVarPatchInput!], $secretFiles: [EnvGroupSecretFilePatchInput!], $saveMode: String!, $expectedRevision: String) {
  patchEnvGroupEnvironment(
    id: $id
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
    saveMode: $saveMode
    expectedRevision: $expectedRevision
  ) {
    envVarKeys
    secretFileNames
    revision
    affectedServiceIds
    failedServiceIds
    pendingServiceIds
    rolledOut
    __typename
  }
}
